title: Dandadan
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Momo Ayase, who believes in ghosts, and Okarun, who believes in aliens, make a bet and are each pulled into the other's belief. Momo gains psychic powers and Okarun is possessed by a spirit, and together with new friends they fight spirits, yokai and aliens, with an early arc about recovering Okarun's stolen testicles.
life_message: It holds up friendship, courage and shared meals as what carries people through strange and frightening times.
